note: KPI/metric definitions for dashboards and reports. 'format' guides display; 'goodDirection' colors trend. Never surface a metric on a dashboard without a definition here.

metrics.name: Time to Access
metrics.definition: Median time from request submission to fulfillment.

metrics.name: Approval Turnaround
metrics.definition: Median time a request spends in pending-approval.

metrics.name: Pending Approvals
metrics.definition: Count of open approval tasks for the current persona.

metrics.name: Certification Completion
metrics.definition: % of certification items decided in active campaigns.

metrics.name: On-Time Certification Rate
metrics.definition: % of campaigns completed by due date.

metrics.name: Dormant Access
metrics.definition: Entitlements unused beyond the dormancy threshold.

metrics.name: Time-Bound Access Share
metrics.definition: % of active grants that are time-bound.

metrics.name: High-Risk Access
metrics.definition: Count of high/critical-risk grants in effect.

metrics.name: JML Automation Rate
metrics.definition: % of lifecycle access changes applied automatically vs. manually.
